result.summary: The page is largely functional, but a raw localization key is rendered as a section heading, and there are minor inconsistencies in card styling and truncated content.

issues.description: The second section heading displays the raw i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a translated label such as 'Popular near you'.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation string for the 'home_feed.popular_title' key and add a fallback so raw keys are never shown to users.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the two restaurant cards use inconsistent backgrounds — the first is a light/white circle, the second is a dark circle — creating visual inconsistency and different contrast levels.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button treatment (e.g., always a semi-transparent dark scrim with a white icon) so it reads consistently over any image.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is clipped mid-title ('Trattoria Piccol') with no visual affordance that the row scrolls horizontally.
issues.suggestion: Add a peek/fade edge or partial card offset and ensure titles truncate with an ellipsis rather than being hard-cut by the viewport.

issues.description: Category chips row ('All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy…') is cut off at the right edge with no scroll indicator, so additional categories may be missed.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade gradient or chevron affordance at the right edge to signal more filters are available.
